notes.title: INFEST 1.0 IS HERE! 🔥Now Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
Deckbuilders, the moment you’ve been waiting for is finally here—INFEST has officially left Early Access! After over two years of passionate development, endless improvements, and incredible feedback from our community, Version 1.0 is ready to take you deeper into the roguelike deckbuilding adventure you love.

[previewyoutube=SwAHEu8xwdg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A Massive Thank You to Our Community[/h3]

Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have been the driving force behind INFEST’s evolution. From gameplay mechanics to world-building, every corner of the game has been shaped with your help.

This journey has been incredible, and we couldn’t have done it without you.

[h3]What’s New in INFEST 1.0?[/h3]

Since our Early Access launch, INFEST has undergone major transformations to deliver a deeper, more challenging, and more polished experience. Here are just some of the changes we’ve made along the way:
	•	Added overworld names and changed the overworld pathing for more strategic choices.
	•	Improved tutorials with expanded tips for smoother onboarding.
	•	Added confusion indicators to aiming lines for better clarity.
	•	Reworked transform cards to automatically affect multiple element types.
	•	Increased the area of effect for toxic gas clouds.
	•	Difficulty balancing: The game is harder, but fairer!
	•	Enhanced performance and fixed countless bugs.
	•	Addressed sound issues: no more overly loud effects!
	•	Water now conducts electricity that can harm enemies.
	•	Lightning strikes now land the first bolt exactly at your cursor, and create electric sources.
	•	Oil physics improved—it now separates and floats on water.
	•	Double bombs no longer collide with dead enemies.
	•	Fully reworked the block system—blocks now stop entire attacks, including status effects.
	•	Gain block for luck and combos, making every move count.
	•	All characters now start with 8 cards instead of 9 for a tighter deck-building experience.
	•	Introduced new electric bomb props for exciting interactions.
	•	Bombs and switches now display properly over liquids.
	•	Levels optimized with more water and better design flow.
	•	Slower-growing plants for improved pacing.
	•	Improved card deploy sliders for accuracy.
	•	Added the ability to delete your current run in game settings.

…And so much more!

[h3]The Future of INFEST[/h3]

While Version 1.0 is a major milestone, it’s not the end. We’re committed to ensuring INFEST continues to grow and improve. Your feedback will remain essential as we explore new ideas, features, and content.

[h3]INFEST 1.0 Launch Sale[/h3]

To celebrate this momentous occasion, INFEST is on launch discount for a limited time! If you’ve been waiting to dive in or have friends who haven’t joined yet, now’s the perfect time.

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts on INFEST 1.0 and see your strategies as you navigate the alien-infested universe.

-INFEST Team

notes.title: INFEST 1.0 is Coming January 23rd, 2025! 🚀
notes.content:
The time has come! After more than two years of development, countless updates, and incredible feedback from our amazing community, INFEST is officially leaving Early Access on January 23rd, 2025 with the release of Version 1.0!

Your support has been instrumental in shaping INFEST into the roguelike deckbuilder we’ve dreamed of creating. From pixel-perfect battles to immersive procedurally generated adventures, every step of this journey has been made possible by your passion and input.

[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2341560/extras/g1-595.gif?t=1730307581[/img]

What to Expect in 1.0:

	•	Fully Polished Gameplay: All the mechanics and features you’ve loved, refined to perfection.
	•	New Surprises: Prepare for additional content to make the full release extra special.
	•	Optimized Performance: Improvements across the board for the smoothest experience yet.
	•	Achievements and More: Your journey through the alien universe will be even more rewarding!

INFEST’s journey doesn’t stop here. This milestone is the beginning of even greater things, as we continue to grow and expand the universe you’ve helped us build.

Mark your calendars, and join us for this monumental moment on January 23rd, 2025. Let’s make INFEST 1.0 a launch to remember!

Thank you for being part of our journey—we can’t wait to see what you think of INFEST 1.0. 💥

The INFEST Team

notes.title: INFEST Update 0.9.5 – The Road to Version 1.0!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce INFEST Update 0.9.5, packed with gameplay balance updates, level design improvements, bug fixes, and a brand-new quality-of-life feature. This update marks a significant milestone as we gear up to leave Early Access with Version 1.0 very soon!

[b]Key Highlights in 0.9.5[/b]

⚖️ Balancing Improvements
- Weapons, abilities, and enemies have been finely tuned to deliver a more intense and rewarding challenge.
- Strategy is king—your choices will matter more than ever as pacing and difficulty have been refined.

🌌 Level Design Enhancements
- Improved level layouts to provide more dynamic and engaging gameplay.
- New environmental hazards and smarter resource placements make every run fresh and exciting.

🛠️ Bug Fixes
- Addressed several key bugs (the code kind, not the alien kind) to enhance stability and performance.
- Optimized gameplay to ensure smoother runs and better quality of life for all players.

🗑️ New Feature: Delete Game Runs
- You asked, we delivered! You can now delete your current game run directly from the game settings. Whether you want to start fresh or free up space for your next masterpiece of a build, you’re in control.

[b]Version 1.0 is Near[/b]

With this update, INFEST is inching closer to leaving Early Access and launching Version 1.0. Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have shaped the game into what it is today, and we’re almost ready to share the final polished experience with the world. Keep your eyes peeled—the full launch is just around the corner.

[b]We Need Your Feedback[/b]

Your input has been invaluable throughout Early Access, and this update is no different. Let us know what you think about the new balancing, level design, and features as we sprint toward 1.0.

Thank you for joining us on this journey.

-INFEST Team

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V0.9 is LIVE
notes.content:
Survivors, this update brings a whole new level of strategic depth to INFEST! 

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2341560/extras/electric-ezgif.com-optimize.gif?t=1730307254[/img]

Here’s what’s new:

⚡ Dynamic Water-Electricity Interactions
Water now conducts electricity, creating lethal shock zones for enemies—use the environment to your advantage!

🌩 Targeted Lightning
Your lightning strikes have been upgraded! The first bolt now lands exactly where you aim, creating an electrifying source right at the cursor position.

🛢 Enhanced Oil-Water Behavior
Oil now floats atop water, adding extra tactical options for combining elements and manipulating the battlefield.

💥 Improved Bomb Mechanics
Double-launched bombs are now smarter—they won’t collide with a defeated enemy, ensuring a clear path to your next target.

🛡 Reworked Blocking System
Blocking just got a massive upgrade. Blocks now absorb entire attacks, including status effects, rather than just damage points. Earn bonus blocks when you’re lucky or nail a combo!

📜 Streamlined Starting Decks
All characters now start with 8 cards, setting you up for faster and more efficient gameplay right from the start.

💫 More Balances & Tweaks
This update also brings many smaller balance adjustments to fine-tune gameplay and keep INFEST challenging and fun.

Jump into INFEST, experiment with these changes, and let us know your thoughts! Happy deck-building! 

INFEST Team

Added Overworld Names to give more personality to your exploration.

Thank you for your ongoing support. Let us know your thoughts on these updates in the Steam forums or via our [url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord]Discord community[/url]. Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more exciting updates!

-INFEST Team

notes.title: INFEST is releasing NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings, players!

We are thrilled to announce that INFEST is now available on Steam Early Access!

[previewyoutube=e8zkJGcHRp0;full][/previewyoutube]

Infest is a roguelike deckbuilder where every pixel on the battlefield can burn, freeze, corrode, shock, and melt. Carefully craft your deck and deploy cards to alter the environment, buff your stats, and unleash stunning pixel-by-pixel damage upon your enemies!

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]

Innovative Damage Mechanics: Utilize pixel-by-pixel damage mechanics for precise and strategic gameplay.

Elemental Interactions: Harness the power of Fire, Oil, Ice, Poison Gas, Water, and Growing Plants to outsmart your enemies.

Deck Customization: Build and upgrade your deck with unique cards, tailored to your preferred playstyle.

Procedurally Generated Levels: Navigate through an ever-changing alien world with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two runs are the same.

Non-combat Rooms: Encounter various locations including shops, hospitals, and bonus challenge rooms, adding depth and variety to your journey.

Achievements and Steam Cloud Support: Track your progress and carry your game data across multiple devices.

[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]

We believe in the power of community feedback. Early Access allows us to refine and expand INFEST with your invaluable input. Your feedback will help shape the final version of the game, ensuring it is as engaging and polished as possible.

[h3]Join Our Community[/h3]

We invite you to join our growing community of players. Share your experiences, suggest improvements, and help us make INFEST the best it can be. Follow our Community Hub or chat with us directly on [url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord]Discord.[/url]

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. We can't wait to see how you tackle the challenges of INFEST!

See you in the alien universe,
The INFEST Development Team
